description:
## Features

Ported from [Morphe](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches).

### YouTube Music
- **Scrobbling:** Send played tracks to ListenBrainz (user token) and Last.fm (username and password), with optional "Now Playing" status, "love" on like for Last.fm, minimum song duration and scrobble delay sliders, and metadata cleanup. Settings: RVX → **Scrobbling**.
- **Playlist track tap action:** Tapping a track in a playlist or album can play only that track or add it to the queue, instead of replacing the queue with the whole playlist. Settings: RVX → Player.
- **Audio/video switch:** The Song side of the Song/Video switch in the player swaps the current track between its song and official music video versions. Settings: RVX → Player (YouTube Music 9.00 and newer).
- **Change pitch with speed:** Pitch rises and falls with the playback speed. Settings: RVX → Video.

## Notes
- Switching between the song and video versions turns shuffle off.
- A track with no song or video counterpart is not switched.
- "Change pitch with speed" applies on the next speed change or track.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.7.0...v1.8.0)
